scripts.predev: vp run build-search-index && vp run build-pinyin-lookup
scripts.prebuild: vp run build-search-index && vp run build-pinyin-lookup
scripts.test: vp run test:unit && vp run test:integration && vp run test:e2e
scripts.test:data-tools: node tests/data-pipeline-checkers.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/python -p 'test_*.py' && sh tests/test-upload-dictionary-guards.sh
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf coverage && vp run test:unit --coverage && vp run test:integration --coverage --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage/integration --coverage.reporter=text-summary --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.thresholds.statements=0 --coverage.thresholds.branches=0 --coverage.thresholds.functions=0 --coverage.thresholds.lines=0 && vp run test:coverage:e2e && node scripts/merge-coverage.mjs
scripts.test:coverage:e2e: E2E_COVERAGE=1 vp run build && E2E_COVERAGE=1 E2E_SKIP_BUILD=1 playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:coverage:release: vp test run --project unit tests/unit/release-deploy.test.ts tests/unit/release-rollback.test.ts tests/unit/wrangler-versions.test.ts tests/unit/smoke-probe.test.ts tests/unit/deployment-state.test.ts --coverage --coverage.include=scripts/release-deploy.mjs --coverage.include=scripts/release-rollback.mjs --coverage.include=scripts/lib/wrangler-versions.mjs --coverage.include=scripts/lib/smoke-probe.mjs --coverage.include=scripts/lib/deployment-state.mjs --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage/release --coverage.thresholds.statements=100 --coverage.thresholds.functions=100 --coverage.thresholds.lines=100 --coverage.thresholds.branches=100
scripts.deploy: env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV vp run build && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV node scripts/release-publish.mjs && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV node scripts/release-deploy.mjs
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging vp run build && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging node scripts/release-publish.mjs && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging node scripts/release-deploy.mjs
scripts.deploy:publish-only: env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV vp run build && env -u CLOUDFLARE_ENV node scripts/release-publish.mjs
scripts.deploy:publish-only:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging vp run build && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging node scripts/release-publish.mjs
